generations.name: Original (2016-2018)
generations.notes: Launch Sept 2015 as MY2016: 60D (75 kWh software-limited, July-Oct 2016), 75D, 90D (to June 2017), 100D and P100D (Aug 2016). Supercharging on V2 (~120 kW class; general knowledge). 75D/100D/P100D continue into MY2019 before the May 2019 Raven change and fall in the raven generation by model year. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tesla_Model_X

generations.name: Raven (2019-2021)
generations.notes: May 2019 engineering refresh (Raven drivetrain) on the 100 kWh pack: Long Range, Performance, Standard Range (2019-2020), Long Range Plus (Feb 2020 on). DC 200 kW (V3) at launch, 225 kW by software June 2020, later 250 kW (thicker wiring). Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tesla_Model_X ; https://electrek.co/2020/06/24/tesla-model-s-x-supercharging-rate-increase-225-kw/ ; https://insideevs.com/news/433707/thicker-wires-model-sx-charging-250-kw/

generations.name: 2022 refresh (Long Range and Plaid)
generations.notes: Refresh with Plaid; EPA and NRCan list the refreshed Model X and Plaid from MY2022, so the boundary is clean by model year. 250 kW Supercharging. The June 2025 refresh (front camera, wheels, third-row space, lighting) lists no charging change. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tesla_Model_X
